A real-authority manifest with an identity log key fails MANIFEST_KEY_SCHEMA in all three modes.
Small-order authority and witness pins and witness registration are rejected.
Unanchored integrity verification with a retained checkpoint raises ValueError.
New SQLite database/WAL/SHM modes are 0600 under umask 022; unsafe existing stores are rejected.
Noncanonical records, checkpoints, receipts and status JSONL are rejected.
Four short-passphrase cases fail before filesystem access; ASCII and UTF-8 16-byte passphrases produce readable PKCS8 keys.
Three legacy short-passphrase keys remain readable; wrong passwords fail, ciphertext and 0600 permissions remain unchanged, and overwrite is refused.
Installed author, keywords, classifiers, Apache-2.0 license, project URLs and cryptography>=50.0.0 metadata match the accepted package.
